name: Disk
author: dbarke
description: Filesystem usage in the bar, every mount metered in the panel, and a fill-rate projection when something is actively eating the disk.

barWidget.description: One filesystem on the bar, all of them in the panel, with a warning before you run out and a projection when one is filling.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Disk usage moves slowly. Polling harder than this only spawns processes -- but the fill projection does get sharper.

schema.label: Mount point on the bar
schema.description: Which filesystem the bar reading summarises. Falls back to the fullest one if this mount is not present.

schema.label: Warning threshold (%)
schema.description: At or above this the reading turns urgent. 0 disables.

schema.label: Warn about any filesystem
schema.description: Tint the bar when some other mount crosses the threshold, so a full /home is visible while the bar is showing /.

schema.label: Ignore filesystems smaller than (GB)
schema.description: Keeps EFI stubs and small loop mounts out of the list.

schema.label: Collapse subvolumes
schema.description: One row per underlying device. Without this, btrfs subvolumes read as several disks that are all equally full.
